identity.name: DataVision International
identity.description: A 25+ year old authoritative research & statistics consultancy. The design must feel like a McKinsey or BCG report came to life: precise, high-contrast, data-driven, and undeniably premium.
identity.emotional_tone: Authority, Precision, Trust, Insight, African Innovation

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' - Classic Authority meets Modern Data

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H3. It conveys history and trust. Tracking: tight (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all body text, UI elements, and data visualizations. It conveys clarity and modernity.

typography.install_instructions: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Crimson+Text:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,400;9..40,500;9..40,700&display=swap');

usage_rules.primary: Use for Hero sections, Footers, and strong Section Breaks. Deep Navy conveys infinite depth.
usage_rules.accent: Use SPARINGLY. Only for primary CTAs ('Partner With Us') and key data highlights. Never for backgrounds.
usage_rules.background: Keep 80% of the site White or very light grey (Surface Alt). Authority comes from white space.
usage_rules.text: Body text should be #1e293b (Slate 800) for readability, never pure black.

colors.gradients: No full screen gradients. Use subtle 'spotlight' gradients on dark backgrounds: radial-gradient(circle at top right, #1e293b 0%, #0a1628 100%).

strategies.hero: Asymmetric split. Text on left (6 cols), Visual/Map on right (6 cols).
strategies.features: Bento Grid. Use col-span-4 and col-span-8 variants to break monotony.
strategies.stats: Horizontal strip with vertical dividers. Large numbers (text-6xl+).
strategies.testimonials: Carousel with heavy left padding. Quote marks as massive background watermarks.

buttons.primary: bg-[#e63946] text-white hover:bg-[#d02835] rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-sm shadow-none transition-all hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.secondary: border-2 border-[#0a1628] text-[#0a1628] hover:bg-[#0a1628] hover:text-white rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-sm transition-all

cards.style: Flat, white background, 1px border (#e2e8f0). NO SHADOW by default. On hover: border-l-4 border-l-[#e63946] and subtle shadow-lg.

map.style: Minimalist SVG map. Africa continent only. Countries with projects highlighted in Red or Teal. Tooltip on hover.

navigation.style: Sticky, white background, mild border-b. Logo on left, Links centered, 'Partner' CTA on right.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle 'noise' overlay on dark sections to prevent banding and add premium feel.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React (already installed). Use thin strokes (1.5px).
visual_enhancers.motion: Use framer-motion. Stagger children for lists. Fade-up for sections. Smooth, slow transitions (0.6s ease-out).

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL: yarn add framer-motion react-simple-maps d3-scale
SETUP: Add the Google Fonts import to src/index.css immediately.
COMPONENT OVERRIDE: Modify Shadcn Button to be square/sharp (rounded-none) to match the 'Consultancy' aesthetic.
NAVBAR: Create a responsive Navbar with a 'Mega Menu' structure for 'Services' and 'Practice Areas'.
MAP: Create a component 'AfricaProjectMap.js' using react-simple-maps. Focus on East Africa (Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda) but show the whole continent.
STATS: Use 'framer-motion' for animated counters that count up when in view.
FORMS: Ensure Contact Form has a hidden 'honeypot' field for bot protection.
ADMIN: The Admin Panel should use a Sidebar layout (Shadcn Resizable or standard flex) and be distinctly functional vs the marketing site.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Use generous padding. A section should never feel cramped.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (APCA standards).
Micro-interactions on every button and card (hover lift, border color change).
